name: han-human-robot-household-instruction-benchmark-v1
description:
Human–Robot Household Instruction Benchmark
	

This dataset serves as a benchmark for evaluating
how humanoid robots interpret simple household
instructions expressed in natural language.
The dataset focuses on clarity, ambiguity,
and task grounding in domestic environments.

	
		
		Research Objective
	

To support reproducible evaluation of
instruction understanding in humanoid robotics.

	
		
		Use Cases
	


HRI benchmarking
Instruction grounding

reputation: A targeted benchmark for human–robot instruction grounding with limited but growing adoption in HRI and domestic robotics research.
